raw_queries.description: Query-history rows written for the downstream parser.

fields.name: QUERY_ID
fields.description: Warehouse-assigned query id, unique within the account. The parser's join key.

fields.name: START_TIME
fields.description: When the query began executing. Must be a real timestamp column — a stringified timestamp here is the defect this declaration exists to catch.

fields.name: CREDITS_USED
fields.description: Compute credits billed for the query. Absent on warehouses that do not meter per query.

fields.name: ROWS_PRODUCED
fields.description: Row count the query returned. Declared decimal because a Snowflake NUMBER lands as parquet decimal128; asserting float would mis-flag it or lose precision.

fields.name: YEAR
fields.description: Partition column derived from START_TIME. The parser prunes on it, so a string here silently disables partition pruning.

fields.name: SESSION_PARAMS
fields.description: Session settings in force for the query. Physically a string column, semantically a JSON blob — collapsing the two would defeat this hop's check.

transformed_entities.description: Transformed entities streamed to the publish step.

fields.name: typeName
fields.description: Atlan type this record instantiates, e.g. Table. Publish routes on it.

fields.name: attributes
fields.description: Container for the entity's attributes. Declared so a record that flattened them to top level is caught before publish reads it.

fields.name: attributes.qualifiedName
fields.description: Stable identity of the entity. Publish upserts on it, so a missing or non-string value creates duplicates rather than failing.

fields.name: attributes.name
fields.description: Display name shown in the UI.

fields.name: attributes.lastSyncRunAt
fields.description: When this entity was last written by a run. Absent on the first sync, set on every later one.

fields.name: attributes.columns
fields.description: Child columns carried inline on a table entity. Absent for entity types that have none.

fields.name: attributes.columns[]
fields.description: One column. `required` on the paths below reads per element, so an empty columns array satisfies them vacuously.

fields.name: attributes.columns[].name
fields.description: Column name as it appears in the source.

fields.name: attributes.columns[].order
fields.description: Ordinal position of the column within the table, 1-based.

fields.name: attributes.tags
fields.description: Source-side tags on the entity. Absent when the source has no tagging.

fields.name: attributes.tags[]
fields.description: One tag. Elements are plain strings, not objects.

fields.name: customAttributes
fields.description: Source-specific extras passed through untouched. Type deliberately unasserted — the shape is the source's, not ours.

upstream_lineage.description: Lineage edges this app reads from an upstream producer.

fields.name: source_qualified_name
fields.description: Qualified name of the upstream asset the edge starts at.

fields.name: target_qualified_name
fields.description: Qualified name of the downstream asset the edge ends at.

fields.name: process_id
fields.description: Id of the process that produced the edge. Groups edges into one lineage process on read.
